description: This is a test source file for the PatientState class in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests for methods like getActive and compareTo within the org.openmrs package.

classes.name: PatientStateTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the PatientState class methods such as getActive and compareTo.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up date ranges for tests before each test method.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnFalseIfVoidedAndDateInRange
methods.description: Tests that getActive returns false if the PatientState is voided and the date is within the range.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnFalseIfVoidedAndDateNotInRange
methods.description: Tests that getActive returns false if the PatientState is voided and the date is outside the range.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnTrueIfNotVoidedAndDateInRange
methods.description: Tests that getActive returns true if not voided and the date is within the range.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnTrueIfNotVoidedAndDateInRangeWithNullStartDate
methods.description: Tests that getActive returns true when startDate is null, date is in range, and not voided.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnTrueIfNotVoidedAndDateInRangeWithNullEndDate
methods.description: Tests that getActive returns true when endDate is null, date is in range, and not voided.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnTrueIfNotVoidedAndBothStartDateAndEndDateNulled
methods.description: Tests that getActive returns true when both startDate and endDate are null.

methods.name: getActive_shouldCompareWithCurrentDateIfDateNull
methods.description: Tests that getActive compares with the current date when input date is null.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnFalseIfNotVoidedAndDateEarlierThanStartDate
methods.description: Tests that getActive returns false if date is before startDate and not voided.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnFalseIfNotVoidedAndDateLaterThanEndDate
methods.description: Tests that getActive returns false if date is after endDate and not voided.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnPositiveIfStartDatesEqualAndThisEndDateNull
methods.description: Tests compareTo returns positive when startDates are equal and this PatientState has a null endDate.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnNegativeIfThisStartDateNull
methods.description: Tests compareTo returns negative when this PatientState has a null startDate.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldPassIfTwoStatesHaveTheSameStartDateEndDateAndUuid
methods.description: Tests compareTo returns zero when two states have same startDate, endDate, and UUID.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnPositiveOrNegativeIfTwoStatesHaveTheSameStartDatesEndDatesAndUuids
methods.description: Tests compareTo returns non-zero when two states have same startDate and endDate but different UUIDs.
